name: Newport Sea Salt Co.
old_description: Our small veteran owned artisanal sea salt company follows the traditional and unhurried process of crafting small batches of 100% pure and natural sea salt. Nothing added, nothing taken away. Our local Sea salt contains no anti-caking, bleaching or iodine additives. However, it does retain numerous trace minerals such as Calcium, Magnesium and Potassium. Our seawater is hand harvested from the pristine waters of Brenton Reef, along the beautiful and historic Ocean Drive of
about:
Newport Sea Salt Co. operates from Newport, Rhode Island, where husband-and-wife team Matt and Tami Mullins founded the business after Matt’s 20-year career as a U.S. Naval Officer. The veteran-owned, woman-owned small business began with a desire to stay connected to the sea and to produce artisanal sea salt using traditional hand-harvesting methods.

The company hand-harvests seawater from Brenton Reef at high tide, filters it, and evaporates it in small batches to produce 100% natural flake sea salt with no additives. The product line includes plain flake salt and blended varieties such as Rosemary & Thyme, Butcher’s Blend, Bella Napoli, and Fire Salt. Production is small-scale, with the Mullins family and their sons Matthew and Connor comprising the crew.

Newport Sea Salt Co. sells directly to consumers at farmers markets and pop-up events across Rhode Island, and through retail partners including specialty food shops, cheese purveyors, and seafood markets in Rhode Island, New York, and California. The salt is also used by restaurant chefs and home cooks as a finishing salt.

The founders emphasize their unhurried, traditional process and the purity of their source water—an approved shellfish-growing area monitored by the Rhode Island Department of Environmental Management. They highlight that their salt retains trace minerals such as calcium, magnesium, and potassium, and contains no anti-caking agents, bleach, or iodine.

name: Nextern
old_description: Joined as CTO in 2022, bringing over 20 years of medical device experience across Interventional, Structural Heart, CRM, and Orthopedics. Co-founded Endogenex and Conventus. R&D leadership at St. Jude Medical and Boston Scientific.
about:
Nextern is headquartered in Maple Grove, Minnesota. Founded in the early 2000s as an engineering and manufacturing partner for industrial components, the company shifted its focus to medical device electromechanical systems in 2016. In 2022, it acquired NPX Precision Technologies, adding nitinol and specialty alloy expertise, and consolidated product development into its new Maple Grove headquarters in 2024.

The company provides vertically integrated medical device development and manufacturing across four pillars: product development, manufacturing, precision technologies (NPX), and consulting services. Its capabilities span design-for-manufacturability, phase-gate development, agile sprints, nitinol shape-setting, laser cutting and welding (±0.0005″ tolerance), catheter shaft assembly, braiding, coiling, tip forming, and regulatory, clinical, and quality consulting. Operations run across five global sites: Maple Grove (HQ, development, manufacturing), Cartago, Costa Rica (manufacturing), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (manufacturing), Kenosha, Wisconsin (precision components), and Shenzhen, China (strategic sourcing).

Nextern serves OEMs, clinicians, and innovators in the medical device sector, with deep clinical market expertise in peripheral vascular (specialty wires, thrombectomy systems, renal denervation), interventional cardiology (delivery catheters, IVL catheters, balloon catheters), neuromodulation (pulse generators, implantable leads, wearable neurostim), electrophysiology (PFA generators, RF generators, ablation catheters), and structural heart (transcatheter delivery, implant frames, occlusion devices).

The company’s stated mission is to partner across the entire product lifecycle to solve patient needs and improve lives. Its differentiation rests on a vertically integrated model that embeds manufacturability from day one, a BioSimulation Lab for realistic device testing, and a phase-gate process designed to eliminate uncertainty early. The 2026 launch of consulting services extends its reach into regulatory strategy, clinical evidence, quality systems, and lifecycle management.

name: Nicholas and Company Salt Lake City
old_description: Since 1939, Nicholas and Company has supplied restaurants, fed families, and supported employees in the Greek tradition of Philotimo. We have built our foundation on a commitment to honorably serve the communities we live and work in, both for today and for future generations.
about:
Nicholas and Company operates from Salt Lake City, Utah, where it was founded in 1939 by Nicholas Mouskondis. The business remains family-owned, now led by the fourth generation of the Mouskondis family, and conducts its operations according to the Greek principle of philotimo — a commitment to honorable service to customers, employees, and the community.

The company functions as a broadline foodservice distributor across six territories in the Intermountain West. It maintains 16.7 million square feet of temperature-controlled warehouse space and stocks more than 14,000 unique products, ranging from fresh produce and center-of-plate proteins to canned goods, beverages, non-food supplies, and flowers. A fleet of over 100 climate-controlled tractors and trailers, equipped with scan-based picking and delivery tracking, supports daily distribution to customer sites.

Customers include independently owned restaurants, regional and national chains, healthcare facilities, government agencies, and educational institutions. The company fields dedicated teams for healthcare nutrition compliance, government and education procurement regulations, and chain-restaurant consistency programs. It also provides access to 1,800-plus Markon produce items, next-day specialty meat and fish kits, and more than 20 exclusive private-label brands.

Leadership emphasizes that family ownership enables agility and long-term stability compared with larger corporate distributors. The firm reinvests in community food donations, recycling initiatives, and local events, framing its scale and service breadth as tools to sustain the regional food ecosystem rather than merely to expand market share.

old_description: We are a contract manufacturer of custom wire harnesses and electronic circuit board assemblies built to support the quick turn, mixed-use needs of OEM’s and other contract manufacturers. about:
Nihm Electronic Solutions was founded in 2010 by James Bench in Las Vegas, Nevada. The company began as a contract manufacturer focused on custom wire harnesses and electronic circuit board assemblies, aiming to support the quick-turn, mixed-volume needs of OEMs and other contract manufacturers.

Today, Nihm produces wire harnesses, cable assemblies, printed circuit board assemblies (PCBA) using surface-mount technology, and 3D-printed prototypes via FDM and stereolithography. The shop also offers material engraving on metal, glass, wood, plastic, and 3D-printed parts through a partnership with Benchmarx Engraving. Operations run with no minimum or maximum order quantities, accommodating small runs and prototype quantities alike.

The company serves the transportation, medical, robotics, gaming, and communications industries. Its customer base includes original equipment manufacturers and fellow contract manufacturers seeking design-build services, reverse engineering, and first-article inspection.

Nihm differentiates itself with 100% testing on every unit, IPC 610/620-certified assemblers, a Komax Alpha 530 automated wire processor with crimp-force monitoring, and a DI water polishing system for fiber-optic cables. The quality program includes cross-section analysis, CPK process-capability tracking, and CAMI Research computer-guided testers that record pass/fail data for each harness.

old_description: Since 1988, Nile Automotive has been a Leading Supplier of Quality custom molded products.  Our services include the aid in design and project management for plastic component tooling that process in our State-of-the-Art injection molding equipment in the tonnage range of 55-950 tons of clamping force.
about:
Nile Automotive Tennessee, based in Tracy City, Tennessee, has operated since 1988 as a custom plastic injection molding supplier. The company is led by CEO and President NS Rao and began with a focus on delivering quality molded products for the automotive sector.

The company runs two ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 certified plants equipped with 30 injection molding presses ranging from 55 to 1,200 tons of clamping force. Its in-house capabilities cover insert molding, over molding, assembly, hot-stamping, sonic welding, hot-gluing, tape-sealing, painting, chrome plating, and hydro graphics, supported by design and project management for plastic component tooling. Value-added services include decorating, packaging, and logistics.

Nile Automotive serves the automotive, medical, agricultural, and industrial markets, shipping products worldwide from its southeastern U.S. locations. Customers range from OEMs requiring high-volume production to medical device manufacturers needing clean-room assembly.

The company states its differentiation lies in a commitment to continual improvement, a clean and safe working environment, ongoing machine technology upgrades, and rigorous tooling maintenance programs, all aimed at surpassing customer expectations for quality, on-time delivery, and price.

Nissha serves medical device OEMs across three core specializations: clinical wearables, minimally invasive surgical devices, and micro molding with automated assembly. The company differentiates itself through accelerator programs — Clinical Wearables Lab, Design for Excellence (DFX), and AGILE Production Planning — that compress development timelines through on-site, cross-functional collaboration. name: Nj Cable Telecommunications
old_description: Founded in 1965 as a voluntary trade organization, NJCIA companies are key drivers of economic growth, innovation, and technological advancement. These companies provide essential services like broadband, video, and mobile connectivity while creating thousands of local jobs. Their investment in infrastructure is essential to meeting the growing demand for high-quality services, supporting residents, and businesses across the state.
about:
The New Jersey Cable and Internet Association (NJCIA) is headquartered in Trenton, New Jersey. Founded in 1965 as a voluntary trade organization, it serves as the collective voice for the state's major cable telecommunications providers. The association operates under a board of directors drawn from its member companies.

NJCIA does not manufacture products; rather, it provides industry representation, government affairs advocacy, and economic research on behalf of its members—Comcast Cable Communications, Altice USA (operator of the Optimum brand), and Charter Communications (operator of the Spectrum brand). The association reports that its members collectively contribute $12.6 billion in economic impact to New Jersey and sustain approximately 75,975 direct and indirect jobs across all 12 congressional districts. Activities include advocating for broadband infrastructure investment, supporting federal programs such as the Affordable Connectivity Program, and publishing industry data.

The association serves the cable telecommunications, broadband internet, video services, and mobile communications industries in New Jersey. Its work benefits residents and businesses statewide by promoting network expansion and connectivity. As a state chapter affiliated with the National Cable & Telecommunications Association (NCTA), NJCIA coordinates with national policy efforts.

The organization was established to unify the cable industry's voice in Trenton and to demonstrate the sector's economic value to policymakers and the public. Member companies state that continued infrastructure investment is essential to meeting growing demand for high-quality broadband, video, and mobile services.

name: Norco Precision - Metal Fabricator
old_description: Precision machining is essential for producing parts that meet tight tolerances. We deliver high-quality components built to your exact specifications. We ensure each part is produced accurately and efficiently, providing the reliability your projects demand.
about:
Norco Precision, a sheet metal fabricator based in Minneapolis, Minnesota, traces its roots to 1976. The current iteration was launched in 2003 by Phil Nori, a metal fabrication veteran, with a mission to provide fabrication solutions and customer service. In 2023, ownership expanded to include Brandon Vannelli as president and Matt Hansen as co-owner, growing the team from its original two people to seven.

The company operates as a full-service sheet metal fabricator with in-house capabilities including laser cutting (Mitsubishi 8kW fiber laser), shearing (10' x 1/4" hydraulic shear), forming (up to 12 feet, 170 tons), welding (TIG, MIG, spot, stud), punching, deburring, hardware insertion, and assembly. It also coordinates with local partners for machining, painting, plating, grinding, and additional punching. The shop handles steel, aluminum, and stainless steel up to 1/4-inch thick.

Norco Precision serves medical, automation, restaurant, and packaging industries, producing components such as medical equipment enclosures, structural frames for automation, custom metalwork for restaurants, and packaging machinery parts.

The company emphasizes fast response (first contact within two business days), quality-first stage-gate inspection, and a local-partner approach, aiming to be the "shop down the road" for Twin Cities OEMs.

about:
Nordic Foods, Inc. was conceived and opened in 1980 in Kansas City, Kansas, by three principals with deep experience in the meat industry. The business is now owned and operated by the second generation — Ted Jovanovic and Jason Hall, sons of the remaining two principals — who have reshaped the company to meet evolving market demands.

The company operates a 47,000-square-foot facility, its third location, designed for its unique manufacturing requirements. Nordic Foods produces a range of meat products including raw, solid, chopped and formed, breaded and unbreaded items. Its capabilities span meat processing, co-packing, and wholesale meats, with product lines such as solid muscle cuts, breaded beef steaks, liver portions, and seasoned beef blends with onions, peppers, and proprietary sauces.

Nordic Foods primarily serves institutional customers and food service distributors nationwide. It assists clients in developing products with specific characteristics, often under private label or proprietary formulations, shipping to distributors across the country.

The company states its goal is to manufacture safe, quality food products in sufficient quantities to continuously satisfy customers while supporting employees and families. It emphasizes high sanitation, rigorous quality and production controls, and the delivery of consistent, reasonably priced products in a timely manner.

old_description: North Alabama Fabricating Company (NAFCO) is a structural steel fabricator headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama, in continuous operation since 1954. The company provides engineering, fabrication, and erection of structural steel for power plants, commercial buildings, aircraft hangars, material-handling systems, and warehouses, holding CWB-certified welding procedures for its fabrication work.
about:
North Alabama Fabricating Company (NAFCO) is a structural steel fabricator headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama. Founded in 1954 by World War II veteran John Parrish, the business began as a structural detailing specialist and expanded into engineering, fabrication, and erection of complex steel projects. It remains a third-generation, family-owned operation under the Parrish family.

The company provides a full range of steel services — structural and industrial fabrication, erection, OEM subassemblies, in-house detailing (using Tekla and SDS/2), engineering, preconstruction design-assist, turnkey EPC for bulk material handling, sophisticated shop-applied coatings, and shop-applied fireproofing. NAFCO operates three fabrication sites in Alabama and a Chicago-based engineering division, Wolf Point Engineers & Contractors. It employs over 200 people and handles projects ranging from 20 to 20,000 tons, claiming to be the largest specialized conveyor fabricator in the United States.

NAFCO serves power generation, commercial construction, aviation, material handling, warehousing, industrial plants, waste recycling, forestry, construction equipment, pulp and paper, aggregate mining, and heavy minerals. Concrete project examples include Schenck Silos, Naheola Biomass Ductwork, Second Line Stages Expansion, CPS Energy, Cliff’s Oak Grove, Cliff’s Bloom Lake, Bryant Denny Stadium renovations, and the Birmingham News Building.

The company emphasizes a one-stop-shop model with all services in-house, a “Quality first. Production second. Safety always.” motto, and AISC-certified facilities with Sophisticated Paint Endorsement (P1) and AWS/CWB welding certifications. Its turnkey capability from detailing through erection and coatings is cited as a key differentiator.
